text:
Iris: Quick one  I had to pay a consulate visa fee and a "service surcharge" at the embassy desk today (local card machine added a 4.5% foreign processing fee). Corpcard declined at POS, so I used personal card. Attached photo of receipt (visa_receipt.jpg) and merchant slip (surcharge.jpg). Total charged: visa 160.00 EUR, surcharge 7.20 EUR. Trip: business in Berlin 2026-07-08. @Jordan can you approve reimbursement?
Priya - Finance: Thanks Iris. Two things: 1) We only reimburse the business visa fee; payment processor surcharges (third-party convenience fees) are typically non-reimbursable unless pre-approved. 2) We need line-item evidence that 160.00 EUR is the visa (not a bundled service). Does the receipt show a breakdown or a confirmation page?
Iris: The receipt has two lines: "Visa Fee 160.00 EUR" and a separate terminal line "Service Fee 7.20 EUR" — both on the same thermal printout. I uploaded both images to Concur and entered expense ID EXP-2026-0708-3322. Also attached the appointment confirmation that mentions the visa fee amount.
Jordan - Manager: Approving the visa itself. For the service surcharge: can finance confirm policy? If it's a mandatory processor fee at secure embassy terminals, maybe exception. Iris, pls include a short note in Concur: "mandatory POS surcharge; no other payment option available" if that's the case.
Priya - Finance: If surcharge was mandatory (no cash or corpcard option), we can escalate for exception. Please add the Concur note and set expense code to `TR_VISAS`. We'll review the merchant descriptor, and CardOps will check whether the corpcard decline was related to MCC or 3DS checks.
CardOps: Created ticket CORP-CARD-11678 to investigate decline at merchant descriptor "EMBASSY PAYMENTS GMBH". Please attach the POS terminal trace if available. Some embassy kiosks block corporate BINs for security.
Iris: Concur note added as requested and included screenshot of payment screen saying "Card declined: contact issuer". I don't have the POS trace; embassy staff said the terminal only provides a receipt.
Priya - Finance: OK we'll process visa fee reimbursement for 160.00 EUR converted to USD at the CCFX rate on the expense date. For the 7.20 EUR surcharge we need one of: (a) manager pre-approval, (b) proof that surcharge was mandatory AND corpcard would have been refused for security reasons, or (c) a policy exception approved by finance leader. For now we'll queue the visa fee and hold the surcharge pending CardOps findings.
ExpenseBot: Expense EXP-2026-0708-3322 submitted by Iris at 2026-07-08 15:24 UTC. Status: awaiting finance review.
Jordan - Manager: I approve the surcharge as exceptional given embassy constraints. Jordan approves surcharge $7.20 EUR on record. @Priya - Finance please mark as manager-exception so ops knows.
Priya - Finance: Noted Jordan's approval. We'll mark the surcharge as manager-exception and process total reimbursement of 167.20 EUR (converted). If CardOps confirms corpcard BIN blocks, we'll add a note to card ops runbook to whitelist the merchant descriptor if possible. Expect reimbursement in 5 business days once FX conversion logged. :white_check_mark:
